scope: Paired, frozen base-Qwen/LoRA development diagnostics only. No new training, protected evaluation, trading or model promotion.

protocol.exposure: Already-exposed September-October 2025 development, NOT an independent holdout
protocol.sample_selection: Even rank indices computed from pinned file count before later-development labels; no profit-sign or session cherry-picking
protocol.native_input: Only the original causal feature prompt; the worker packet has no dataset path, targets or target hashes
protocol.decoding: Greedy BF16 CUDA, no chat template or constrained decoding; maximum 48 new tokens, terminal EOS required
protocol.output_contract: Exact JSON keys/classes and cost monotonicity; no repairs, parsing rescue or retries
protocol.scoring: Coverage, correct/total including invalid as incorrect, correct/valid, per-class precision/recall/F1, supported-class macro F1/balanced accuracy and directional precision/recall
protocol.invalid_outputs: Kept separate, not silently converted to no-opportunity

native_attempt.generation_completion: Unverified: an intent does not prove a completed generation

diagnosis_and_repair.reproduced_behavior: PEFT disable_adapter() context exit calls adapter enabling, which sets active LoRA requires_grad flags true even with an inference-only adapter
diagnosis_and_repair.original_exception_origin: Not captured by the original failure artifact; matching frozen-guard failure is the best-supported explanation, not a recovered native traceback
diagnosis_and_repair.additional_runtime_probe: One tiny randomly initialized CPU Qwen generation passed; no GPU or market checkpoint/data was used
diagnosis_and_repair.repair: After base-mode context exit, validate that any re-enabled flags belong only to bounded q/v LoRA parameters, refuse every actual gradient or unexpected trainable base parameter, then restore frozen inference flags
diagnosis_and_repair.future_failure_diagnostics: Allowlisted boundary error codes, without native messages, input dumps or credentials
diagnosis_and_repair.gpu_comparison_after_repair: Not run; a new source-bound registration is required. The failed registration cannot be reused with repaired code.

limitations: No GPU comparison scores were produced. CPU repair verification does not establish successful full-size GPU inference.
Forty supervised examples are a small, label-observability-conditioned and imbalanced development sample, not proof of predictive or financial performance.
Class matching at three cost settings is not a PnL backtest. Magnitudes, wrong-way losses, CFD basis, broker spreads/commissions, latency and fills are not established by class labels.
The candidate still has only twenty market-data training updates and remains outside trading and production inference.
next: Freeze a fresh registration for the repaired source, retaining the same forty rank-selected development cases and fixed controls. Do not overwrite or resume the failed run.
Run one separately bounded comparison and verify all eighty predictions before scoring; no automatic retries or successful-subset processing.
Only after diagnostics, preregister a larger train-only experiment. Keep the separate 2026 test/lockbox outcomes out of development and tuning.
